changes: Git status returns HEAD, symbolic target and exact HEAD/index revision tokens. Commit requires those versions, explicit author identity and bounded message.
Only a private copied index feeds raw write-tree/commit-tree; original index and unstaged bytes remain untouched. Empty/unmerged/in-progress operations and unsafe metadata paths are rejected.
An owned index.lock and Git prepared expected-old-HEAD ref transaction fence publication. Post-prepare validation reads only descriptors, then a durable candidate record precedes commit dispatch.
All one-shot Git operations require exclusive child ownership before spawning. Whole-helper descendant cleanup cannot reap an already-running independent executor.
Lost publication acknowledgement stays unknown, retains candidate diagnostics and is never replayed. Unknown shutdown retains the owned index lock; foreign/replaced locks are never deleted.
Missing-resource error classification is now not_found while dispatched mutations retain unknown delivery.

validationChain.coverage: Prepared ref locks block symbolic HEAD change, index.lock blocks add, original index bytes preserved, final HEAD follows commit/abort.

validationChain.cause: The post-prepare status check launched rev-parse. Its whole-helper descendant cleanup terminated the active prepared update-ref child. Closing its broken stdin then skipped remaining cleanup.
validationChain.repair: Use process-free HEAD-file/index verification under Git-held CAS locks; reject any existing child at one-shot Git/publication entry. Broken stdin closure no longer skips descendant confirmation or descriptor closure.

validationChain.coverage: Real staged-only commit/replay, callback/filter/signing denial, unborn/detached heads, stale HEAD/index, empty/unmerged/in-progress index, unsafe refs/foreign locks, prepared-transaction conflict, lost result, unknown cleanup and pre-existing child preservation; all prior workspace/recovery/worktree/resource regressions.
not_found remains not_sent before dispatch and unknown after dispatch; internal paths remain absent from generic failures.

limits: No full suite, paid inference, external MCP, remote Git traffic or online service mutations.
Gateway configuration-idle routing, minimized receipts, ledger reconciliation and supervisor witness integration are owned by root and have separate targeted tests.
Git locks coordinate cooperative Git writers; arbitrary same-native-UID filesystem mutation is not a security isolation boundary.
No automatic Git garbage collection or index-lock deletion after uncertain shutdown. The diagnostic candidate is not acceptance proof.
Source remains unfrozen. The final not_found classification adds only two separately tested handler assertions after the archived 67-test Linux run.
Stage/unstage and dedicated index recovery are subsequent work and are not claimed implemented by this evidence.
